display_long_description:
**Become the blade in Ninja Slash VR, a physics-driven action game built around fast, skill-based sword combat.**

**MASTER PHYSICS-DRIVEN SWORD COMBAT**

Swing, block, stab, and parry using natural VR movements. Your speed, angle, timing, and attack direction determine the result of every clash.

[media]

**PERFORM PRECISE PARRIES**

Blocking alone is not enough. Match the direction of an incoming strike and counter it with force to stagger your opponent and create an opening.

[media]


**SLICE ENEMIES APART**
Target specific body parts and armor sections with location-based damage and physical dismemberment. 

[media]

**MOVE LIKE A CYBER NINJA**

Run, climb, grapple, jump, and use vertical environments to control the battlefield. Close the distance quickly or escape before enemies can surround you.
[media]


**CONTROL TIME**

Activate Bullet Time during critical moments to slow enemy attacks and sharpen your reactions. Dodge projectiles, analyze threats, reposition your blade, and perform precise multi-hit combinations while the world moves in slow motion.

[media]

Every block is physical. Every parry requires timing. Every cut is determined by your own movement.

**Draw your blade. Slow down time. Survive the arena. Become the cyber ninja they were built to fear.**
